name: Bärnstatt
beschreibung: The Bärnstatt is an inn in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser. Scheffau lies in the Tiroler Unterland, nestled in the mountain world of the Wilden Kaiser. The inn offers both overnight accommodation and dining services. The kitchen focuses on traditional Tiroler dishes. From here, guests can go hiking and ski touring. The inn is a typical example of rural hospitality in the region. The rooms are practically furnished.
